1.o: This book is wholly concerning Edom, a nation nearly allied and near adjoining to Israel, and yet an enemy to the seed of Jacob, inheriting the enmity of their father Esau to Jacob. Now here we have, after the preface, ver. 1. I. Threatenings against Edom, 1. That their pride should be humbled, ver. 2-4. 2. That their wealth should be plundered, ver. 5-7. 3. That their wisdom should be infatuated, ver. 8, 9. 4. That their spiteful behaviour towards God's Israel should be avenged, ver. 10-16. II.
1.i: Obadiah is a single page about pride, a family quarrel, and the day God sets things right.
1.p: Lord, keep us humble. Teach us to stand with our family in their trouble, and not look on. Amen.
1.l: If someone close to you is having a bad day, do not laugh. Go sit with them.
q: Obadiah says the proud who live in high places will be brought down. What do you rely on to feel safe?
